description.value: Arundel Mansion is a heritage building constructed in 1910 in downtown New Westminster, offering Edwardian-era furnished suites decorated in craftsman style with bay windows, high ceilings, hardwood floors, and vintage claw-foot tubs. The property also manages the adjacent Towle House Victorian rental homes and a rentable restaurant suite, giving it an unusually eclectic character. New Westminster's SkyTrain connections place central Vancouver about 20 minutes away, making this a historically rich base for cyclists exploring the Lower Mainland.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: rack at 58m; rack at 63m; rack (2 spaces) at 82m; stands (2 spaces) at 88m; rack at 90m; stands (2 spaces) at 90m; stands (2 spaces) at 96m; stands (2 spaces) at 97m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address as 48 Begbie Street, New Westminster BC, matching OSM, but OSM assigns this record to the 'North Vancouver' community — a significant geographic error. Wi-Fi is confirmed by both OSM (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) and the website ('we have free wireless Internet connection'). No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, tools, or any cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the property is located in New Westminster, BC — a significant geographic misclassification.
Website depends heavily on Adobe Flash and appears outdated; some content may be stale or no longer accurate.
OSM email (plethora@blaze.ca) could not be confirmed from website content — email addresses were not visible in the scraped text.
No cycling-specific amenities (bike storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Neither required criterion (secure bike storage, staff bike knowledge) is evidenced anywhere on the website, making WWC accreditation unverifiable without direct contact. The OSM community attribution ('North Vancouver') is also incorrect — the property is in New Westminster — which warrants a data-quality check before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Property is pet-friendly per website ('we are a Family friendly Hotel, that includes the 4 legged members too'). Airport, railway station, bus terminal, and dock pickup is offered by limousine/van. The hosts also operate related properties: Towle House Victorian rental homes in New Westminster and Rosedale Manor on Vancouver Island.
